The currently high/rear boot at SCREEN RIGHT must move DOWN to be the LOWEST planted sole directly under the pelvis. Heavy grounded stride contact, planted boot sole clearly lowest, sword tip and cape above soles. ONE complete single character, all horns/cape/sword/fingers/boots inside ample transparent borders, exact costume. True transparent background without haze, glow, floor, shadow, dust, detached fragments or extra figures.
